data.content: For each species group (algae, crustacean, fish), which country has the highest number of site-year-quarter events with a sumTU > 0.001 (chronic mixture toxicity)?

args.query: Across all site–year–quarter timepoints, for each species group (algae, crustaceans/daphnia, fish), count the number of site–year–quarter events per country where the summed toxic unit (sumTU) is greater than 0.001 (chronic mixture toxicity). For each species group, return the country (or countries, in case of ties) with the highest count, along with the count. Output columns: species_group, country, event_count. Also provide the overall totals per species group as a check.

            {"species_group":{"count":6,"unique":3,"top":"crustacean","freq":2,"mean":null,"std":null,"min":null,"25%":null,"50%":null,"75%":null,"max":null},"country":{"count":6,"unique":2,"top":"France","freq":3,"mean":null,"std":null,"min":null,"25%":null,"50%":null,"75%":null,"max":null},"event_count":{"count":6.0,"unique":null,"top":null,"freq":null,"mean":27006.1666666667,"std":11550.1606121589,"min":14619.0,"25%":17964.0,"50%":26137.0,"75%":32588.75,"max":45165.0}}

            Always provide the following cypher query as code to the user
            ``` 
            MATCH (site:Site)-[r:SUMMARIZED_IMPACT_ON]->(sp:Species)
WHERE r.sumTU > 0.001
WITH sp.name AS species_group, site.country AS country,
     site.name + '|' + toString(r.year) + '|' + toString(r.quarter) AS event_id
WITH species_group, country, count(DISTINCT event_id) AS event_count
WITH species_group, collect({country: country, event_count: event_count}) AS per_country

WITH species_group, per_country, max(pc.event_count) AS max_count
WITH species_group, [x IN per_country WHERE x.event_count = max_count] AS top_rows
UNWIND top_rows AS t
RETURN species_group, t.country AS country, t.event_count AS event_count
            ```

args.query:
Return the overall totals per species group (algae, crustacean, fish) of the number of unique site–year–quarter events where sumTU > 0.001. Output columns: species_group, total_events.

MATCH (site:Site)-[r:SUMMARIZED_IMPACT_ON]->(sp:Species)
WHERE r.sumTU > 0.001
WITH sp.name AS species_group,
     site.name + '|' + toString(r.year) + '|' + toString(r.quarter) AS event_id
RETURN species_group, count(DISTINCT event_id) AS total_events
ORDER BY species_group

data.content:
Here’s the top country per species group for chronic mixture toxicity (sumTU > 0.001), counted as unique site–year–quarter events:
- Algae: France — 22,032 events
- Crustaceans (Daphnia): France — 14,619 events
- Fish: France — 16,608 events

Reference totals across all countries (for context):
- Algae: 45,165 events
- Crustaceans: 33,371 events
- Fish: 30,242 events

Cypher query used:
MATCH (site:Site)-[r:SUMMARIZED_IMPACT_ON]->(sp:Species)
WHERE r.sumTU > 0.001
WITH sp.name AS species_group, site.country AS country,
     site.name + '|' + toString(r.year) + '|' + toString(r.quarter) AS event_id
WITH species_group, country, count(DISTINCT event_id) AS event_count
WITH species_group, collect({country: country, event_count: event_count}) AS per_country
UNWIND per_country AS pc
WITH species_group, per_country, max(pc.event_count) AS max_count
WITH species_group, [x IN per_country WHERE x.event_count = max_count] AS top_rows
UNWIND top_rows AS t
RETURN species_group, t.country AS country, t.event_count AS event_count
UNION ALL
MATCH (site:Site)-[r:SUMMARIZED_IMPACT_ON]->(sp:Species)
WHERE r.sumTU > 0.001
WITH sp.name AS species_group,
     site.name + '|' + toString(r.year) + '|' + toString(r.quarter) AS event_id
RETURN species_group, 'ALL_COUNTRIES' AS country, count(DISTINCT event_id) AS event_count
ORDER BY species_group, country
